::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/report_dashboards"}
#docs
Every tile is validated against the report catalogue as a WHOLE combination — the key, the range preset, `granularity` against what the report will honour, and `group_by` against the dimensions it declares — so a dashboard cannot be saved holding a tile the report layer would later refuse. An empty dashboard IS allowed: you name it, then add tiles. Each person may own at most 50 stored dashboards in an organization, counted across every business and org-level; the built-in presets do not count.

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `business` | `string` | no | Omit for an org-level dashboard |
| `name` | `string` | **yes** | The dashboard's name. |
| `visibility` | `string` | no | Who can see the dashboard. One of `private`, `everyone`. |
| `is_default` | `boolean` | no | Your own default, not the organization's — a default is personal even on a shared dashboard. |
| `tiles` | `array of object` | no | The tiles to put on the dashboard. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `400` | Unknown report key, options the report would refuse, or you already own 50 dashboards |
| `404` | No such business |
| `409` | You already have a dashboard by that name |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/report_dashboards" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Revenue overview"
  }'
```
